name: VeriPatch Gate
description: Reviews npm dependency fixes using VeriPatch verification evidence
about: Reviews npm security dependency updates using VeriPatch's JSON evidence and the actual pull request diff. Reports whether the evidence supports a merge candidate or requires human review, with specific verification gaps and risks. Never edits code, approves changes, or merges pull requests.
features: Compare verified package versions with the PR diff
Check re-scan, build, test and CI outcomes
Identify missing evidence and review blockers
examplePrompt: Review this npm dependency update using VeriPatch's verification report and the PR diff.
